facts.fact: The vendor page claims organic social media posts now reach roughly 2-5% of a business's followers.
facts.quote: The platforms that promised to connect you with customers now show your posts to roughly 2-5% of your followers

facts.fact: Google Local Services Ads charge only when someone contacts the business, not for impressions or clicks, according to the page.
facts.quote: You only pay when someone contacts you, not for impressions or clicks that go nowhere.

facts.fact: The page states that direct mail achieves 4-5% response rates.
facts.quote: While email open rates have dropped below 20% for most businesses, direct mail still achieves 4-5% response rates.

facts.fact: The page recommends one targeted postcard campaign per month as the direct mail option at the $200 budget level.
facts.quote: direct mail (one targeted postcard campaign per month)

facts.fact: The page states that Google Business Profile optimization costs nothing but time.
facts.quote: Optimizing your profile with accurate information, photos, and regular posts costs nothing but time

facts.fact: The page says direct mail can target every home within a 5-mile radius of a business location.
facts.quote: every home in a 5-mile radius of your location

facts.fact: Adwave says businesses can start TV advertising with as little as $30 a day.
facts.quote: Platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works) allow you to start TV advertising with as little as $30 a day.

facts.fact: The page states that most local businesses find $200-500 monthly provides meaningful reach across their target area.
facts.quote: Most local businesses find $200-500 monthly provides meaningful reach across their target area

facts.fact: In the page's example of a $1,000-per-month local advertising budget, streaming TV advertising is allotted $400-500.
facts.quote: You can maintain consistent streaming TV advertising ($400-500)

facts.fact: In the page's example of a $1,000-per-month local advertising budget, monthly direct mail campaigns are allotted $300-400.
In the page's example of a $1,000-per-month local advertising budget, Google Local Services Ads or paid search are allotted $200-300.
facts.quote: add Google Local Services Ads or paid search ($200-300)

facts.fact: The page states that response rates for well-targeted direct mail campaigns average 4-5%, which it says is significantly higher than email or social media; no source is cited.
facts.quote: Response rates for well-targeted direct mail campaigns average 4-5%, significantly higher than email or social media.

facts.fact: The page says most local businesses see measurable results from direct mail in the first campaign cycle, typically within 2-4 weeks.
facts.quote: Most local businesses see measurable results from direct mail in the first campaign cycle, typically 2-4 weeks.

facts.fact: The page says streaming TV advertising often shows initial results in 30 days, with compounding effects over 90 days.
facts.quote: Streaming TV advertising often shows initial results in 30 days, with compounding effects over 90 days as brand awareness builds.

facts.fact: The page says social media organic growth typically requires 6-12 months of consistent effort before generating meaningful traffic.
facts.quote: Social media organic growth, by contrast, typically requires 6-12 months of consistent effort before generating meaningful traffic

facts.fact: The page recommends testing multiple advertising channels for 90 days and measuring actual customer acquisition from each.
facts.quote: The best approach is testing multiple channels for 90 days and measuring actual customer acquisition from each.
